newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds remain quietly in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds remain quietly in afternoon.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market remained quietly this afternoon as buyers stayed sidelined on calls Chicago soymeal futures would ease further after yesterday's near-limit drop, market sources said.
"Business remained slow today as both buyers and sellers were waiting to see what would happen next on Chicago, we only saw light nearby covering," one broker said.

Dutch high protein soymeal traded at $353 a tonne fob Rotterdam for week 12 delivery and at $326 fob for May. Afloat Thai tapioca pellets changed hands at 17.50 marks per 100 kg fob Amsterdam.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
